controls.name: targetLufs
controls.doc: The loudness the face holds the signal at, LUFS (BS.1770, K-weighted).

controls.name: rangeDb
controls.doc: The most the face moves the signal, dB, either way. It comes up at 0, the input bit for bit: nothing moves until it is given room.

controls.name: speedDbPerS
controls.doc: How fast the gain walks, dB per second. A slow walk is a hand on a fader; a fast one reads as compression.

controls.name: gateLufs
controls.doc: Under this the gain holds: a pause is not a quiet passage, and the leveler must not ride up the room between sentences.

controls.name: window
controls.doc: What the loudness is measured over, in the order of the integer the kernel reads: momentary, 400 ms; short, 3 s.

readouts.name: loudnessLufs
readouts.doc: The loudness the detector reads now, LUFS, before the gain.

readouts.name: gainDb
readouts.doc: The gain the face applies now, dB.
